hero_title: Discover knowledge from the open web.
hero_desc: Collect book information responsibly, search your catalogue, save favourites, and explore analytics in a workspace built for you.
feature_one_desc: Our crawler uses a permitted test website, respects robots.txt, and limits request speed.
feature_two_desc: Find books by title, price and rating using real source data, never fabricated samples.
feature_three_desc: Save books and filters, select dark/light themes, and choose your language.
step_one_desc: Set up a personal workspace and your preferences.
step_two_desc: Collect live book data from a controlled sandbox source.
step_three_desc: Filter, analyze and bookmark the books that interest you.
cta_title: Turn raw data into something useful.
cta_desc: Create your workspace and get started with CrawlInsight.
source_disclaimer: Technical sandbox: Books to Scrape. Original book prices are in GBP, not VND.
dashboard_sub: Track collection runs and browse books discovered from the source website.
no_data: No data yet. Run a crawl to begin.
max_pages: Up to 3 catalogue pages per crawl under the current policy.
catalog_sub: Filter by title, original price and rating from the source.
price_notice: Original book prices are GBP. They have not been converted to VND.
bookmarks_sub: Saved books belong to your personal account.
no_bookmarks: You have not saved any books. Browse the catalogue to get started.
history_sub: Crawl jobs created by your account and the results of each session.
analytics_sub: Understand book ratings and categories from real collected data.
analytics_empty: Not enough data to show analytics. Start a crawl.
sources_sub: Transparent data sourcing, scope and responsible-use policy.
source_description: A training sandbox built specifically for learning web scraping.
notes_sources: Arbitrary external URLs are disabled to protect websites. For educational use only.
settings_sub: Make your workspace feel like yours.
guide_sub: Get to know every part of your workspace.
guide_crawl: From Overview, choose the number of pages and start a crawl. Status updates appear in the monitor.
guide_browse: Open Book explorer to search, filter, visit the original source and bookmark books.
guide_save: Use Saved books to manage your collection; you may save up to 20 search filters.
guide_settings: Language and appearance preferences are tied to your account.
guide_reset: Forgot password? Use the link on the sign-in page. Real email delivery requires SMTP configuration.
auth_welcome_sub: Sign in to access your personal data workspace.
auth_create_sub: Explore data sources and save your discoveries.
auth_forgot_desc: Enter your email to get a password-reset link (valid for 20 minutes).
auth_reset_desc: Use at least 10 characters, including letters and numbers.
auth_terms: By proceeding, you agree to use source data responsibly.
session_expired: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
logout_confirm: Do you want to sign out?
